### 🔀 HUBSPOT WEBHOOK ROUTER v1.1

**Current routes:**
  Normalization properties    → Normalization Engine
  canon_engagement_status    → Re-engagement Alert
  Everything else            → Logged and dropped

**Why canon_engagement_status instead of hs_email_last_open_date:**
HubSpot Starter doesn't expose native email engagement
properties as webhook triggers. canon_engagement_status
is our own field — fully subscribable.

When a Cold/Dormant contact opens an email, HubSpot
resets their sends counter. Nightly scorer recalculates
and writes canon_engagement_status: Cold → Active.
That change fires this webhook and triggers the alert.

**Tradeoff vs higher tiers:**
Alerts fire after the 2am scorer run rather than
instantly. On Marketing Hub Pro/Enterprise, HubSpot
exposes hs_email_last_open_date as a webhook trigger
for real-time alerts. Great upgrade conversation.

**To add a new route in future:**
1. Add property name to the ROUTES map in Classify Events
2. Add forward block in Route Events
3. No HubSpot changes needed

**Setup:**
1. Activate this workflow
2. Paste router webhook URL as HubSpot Target URL
3. Update NORMALIZATION_WEBHOOK_URL and
   REENGAGEMENT_WEBHOOK_URL in Route Events node
4. Add canon_engagement_status subscription in HubSpot:
   Contact → Property changed → canon_engagement_status
